name: Permission to Evaluate Form After Oral Request
description: When a parent orally requests a special education evaluation, the employee provides the permission-to-evaluate request form.
deadline: within 10 calendar days of the oral request
quote: If a request is made orally to any professional employee or administrator, that individual shall provide a copy of the permission to evaluate request form to the parents/guardians within ten (10) calendar days of the oral request.
